name: Rust
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The multiplayer survival game. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with Oxide or Carbon for plugins and an optional map wipe on reinstall.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Rust. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 258550) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. The map, saves, blueprints and configs are
# kept, unless Wipe on reinstall is on. Oxide or Carbon is installed by the
# server image when the server starts.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-258550}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Only once the game is installed, so a failed install wipes nothing.
if [ "${REGEN_SERVER:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    echo "Wiping the map and its saves, as Wipe on reinstall is on. Blueprints and player data are kept."
    rm -f server/rust/*.map server/rust/*.sav server/rust/*.sav.*
fi

# The settings the Panel writes into server.cfg at every start need a line
# each to replace.
mkdir -p server/rust/cfg
cfg=server/rust/cfg/server.cfg
touch "$cfg"
for key in server.hostname server.description server.url server.headerimage server.logoimage server.level server.worldsize server.seed server.tags server.levelurl; do
    grep -q "^$key " "$cfg" || echo "$key \"\"" >> "$cfg"
done
echo "Installed Rust build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The text under the name in the server list; \n starts a new line.

variables.name: Website
variables.description: The link behind the server's Visit Website button.

variables.name: Header image
variables.description: A link to the image at the top of the server's listing (512×256).

variables.name: Logo
variables.description: A link to the server's logo in the Rust+ app (256×256).

variables.name: Tags
variables.description: Comma-separated tags for the server list, such as monthly,vanilla.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players online at once.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map to generate: Procedural Map, Barren, HapisIsland, CraggyIsland, or SavasIsland.

variables.name: World size
variables.description: The size of a procedural map, in metres across.

variables.name: World seed
variables.description: The seed of a procedural map, or empty for Rust's default.

variables.name: Custom map link
variables.description: A direct download link to a custom map, used instead of generating one.

variables.name: Mod framework
variables.description: vanilla, oxide (uMod) or carbon, installed or updated when the server starts.

variables.name: Wipe on reinstall
variables.description: Delete the map and its saves on every reinstall, so the next start is a fresh map. Blueprints are kept.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port the server list and player count queries use. Add it as an allocation.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The port for RCON tools, and for the console here. Add it as an allocation to use outside tools.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The RCON password. The console needs it to send commands.

variables.name: Rust+ port
variables.description: The port for the Rust+ companion app, or -1 to turn it off.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Extra arguments
variables.description: More startup arguments, such as +server.pve true.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, such as staging, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam on the next install, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.
